title: Sarkaneez

items.item: water (for the oven version use 1/4 cup)

instructions: Heat the oil; add the onion and chicken and mix for 5 minutes. Add the carrots, chickpeas, salt, cumin, and water. Bring to a boil, then lower the heat.
Add the rice and mix, then bring to a boil again and lower to a simmer for about 20-25 minutes. Add the garlic and mix.
Alternatively, mix everything together and place in a 350°F oven for 1 hour, mix, then bake again for 30 minutes. Add the garlic at the end of cooking.
For the garlic: in a small saucepan, heat the oil until hot. Add the garlic with salt and cook for 30 seconds. Take off the flame and add to the rice.
notes: Stovetop method says 'Add 3 cups rice' while the ingredient list says 2½ cups — kept both as written. Oven temp written as '35 degree' — interpreted as 350°F.
